# Julios Mayem — Portfolio

> Software engineer specialised in computer vision and AI, based in Yaoundé, Cameroon.

## About

Julios Mayem Yota Tamessuing is a software engineer based in Yaoundé, Cameroon.
He holds a professional bachelor's degree in software engineering (graduated first in class, 17.75/20, highest honours) from IUSTE, Yaoundé.
He received the Presidential Excellence Award twice (2021, 2022) and won the GDG Ngaoundéré AI & Google Ecosystem Quiz (2022).
Since 2024 he works at BkSquare SARL as a software developer, hired after a research internship in facial recognition.

## Core expertise

- Computer vision (OpenCV, Python, CustomTkinter)
- Embedded AI / inference on low-resource hardware
- Mobile development (Flutter / Dart)
- Database design (MERISE, MySQL)
- DevOps / CI-CD (Codemagic, GitHub Actions)

## Selected projects

### KKBSECU — Facial recognition system
Stack: Python, OpenCV, CustomTkinter, Firebase, 2TUP methodology
Result: >95% recognition accuracy. Internship thesis scored 19/20.

### GESCOM — Commercial management system
Stack: MERISE, MySQL
Result: manages 1,200+ product references with <2 s query response time.

### Sygalin SAS — School website
Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL
Result: Lighthouse score >90, load time <1.5 s.

### Delicio Food — Mobile food ordering app
Stack: Flutter, Dart, Google Maps SDK, SQLite
Result: <300 ms app startup, 60 fps rendering.

### Android maths quiz game
Stack: Android native (Java)
Result: 500+ exercise variations, APK <15 MB.

Open to: Master's / PhD programmes, AI research contracts, lab positions.
